title: Cardiomyocytes in built organisms spontaneously made phase-matched contractions

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Cardiomyocytes in built organisms spontaneously made phase-matched contractions

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Although signalling between cardiomyocytes was not designed or enforced, cardiac muscle cells in the built organisms spontaneously coordinated to produce coherent, phase-matched contractions that aided locomotion.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Kriegman S 2020, A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms › Discussion

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: For instance, although signaling between cardiomyocytes was not enforced, emergent spontaneous coordination among the cardiac muscle cells produced coherent, phase-matched contractions which aided locomotion in the physically realized designs.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Kriegman S, Blackiston D, Levin M, Bongard J, “A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms”, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America (2020), doi:10.1073/pnas.1910837117; section “Discussion”. Scope: Xenopus cardiac progenitor tissue embedded in reconfigurable organisms

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2020-xenobots-08: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.64

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Phase matching and locomotor contribution can be defined quantitatively. Published videos may resolve coordination, but the causal contribution and prevalence across organisms are only partly testable from available material.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Extract contraction timing from videos, estimate pairwise phase locking among cardiac regions, and relate coherence to displacement relative to phase-shuffled and non-cardiac controls.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
High-resolution contraction time series may not be publicly deposited.

Correlation between synchronization and locomotion does not alone establish that synchronization aided movement.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.68
data adequacy: 0.4
operationalizability: 0.92
analysis feasibility: 0.72
data existence: 0.52

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Phase-matched contraction is a standard physiological measurement and would be distinguishable from independent twitching. The paper reports the coordination and deposits the simulator, which assumes actuation rather than recording it. No public trace archive supports a reanalysis, so the test needs the original timing data or a new recording.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: From contraction or voltage traces in built organisms, compute phase lag among cardiac regions; spontaneous coordination holds if phase-locking exceeds a shuffle of independent cells and was not imposed by the construction protocol.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The data release covers simulation code, not cardiomyocyte timing traces.

Supplementary video, where present, is an illustration rather than a sample of phase measurements.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.25
data existence: 0.25
discriminating power: 0.6
operationalizability: 0.8
data adequacy: 0.2
